column1: # images (ota_0 / ota_1) are updated; `factory` is the minimal USB+OTA recovery
# app and is flashed once at manufacturing.
# Boot selection: the 2nd-stage bootloader reads `otadata` to pick ota_0/ota_1;
# if otadata is empty/invalid it falls back to `factory`. Manufacturing MUST
# write otadata to select ota_0 so a shipped unit boots the application
# recovery (see README "Manufacturing").
# nvs_key is reserved (unused today) and kept only so the immutable table has
# headroom; this open-hardware build does not enable flash encryption.
# `assets` holds the emote/face animation pack (mmap image) shown on the panel
# when no USB host is driving frames. It is a data partition

column1: # table LAYOUT is fixed. The app slots are 2MB each: the application is <1MB today
# and gains the LVGL/gfx emote engine
# devid holds the factory-provisioned device certificate (a v2 ECDSA cert; the
# identity key itself lives in eFuse
# provisioning/). Deliberately NOT flagged `encrypted`: the cert is public data
# whose integrity comes from its CA signature
# provisioning write it with a plain `esptool write_flash` regardless of the
# unit's flash-encryption state. A blank devid is a supported state — the unit
